question: Can even immense material wealth justify giving away this supreme Kaula teaching?
premises: One might possess enough to fill the ocean with jewels.
This is contrasted with giving the teaching.
inference: Even the wealth to fill the ocean with jewels is not a sufficient price for this teaching.
uncertainties: The fused form ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is read as ratnasaṃpūrṇam + akretum or kartum; the exact verbal form is unclear.
plain_english: Even if one had the accumulation to fill the ocean with jewels...
